name: What is the return on investment (ROI) for a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the return on investment (ROI) for a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom renovations consistently offer a strong return on investment, making them a valuable upgrade for homeowners. While the exact ROI can vary based on location, quality of materials, and the extent of the remodel, minor to mid-range bathroom remodels typically recoup a significant portion of their cost, often ranging from 60% to 75% or even more, at resale. Beyond monetary return, a renovated bathroom enhances daily living, improves home functionality, and boosts overall aesthetic appeal, which can also contribute to a faster sale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom renovations offer a good ROI, typically recouping 60-75% or more of their cost at resale, in addition to improving home value and daily living.
